Put the backdrop HDRI here as boxing_ring.hdr (equirectangular .hdr, 2k is plenty).
Suggested: Poly Haven "Basement Boxing Ring" (CC0) - https://polyhaven.com/a/basement_boxing_ring
Without the file the game keeps its plain dark backdrop.
Tune in the browser: ?envrot=90 turns the picture, ?env=assets/env/other.hdr tries another file.
